segments.sn14.22:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“dhātusova, bhikkhave, sattā saṃsandanti samenti.
segments.sn14.22:1.7: upaṭṭhitassatino upaṭṭhitassatīhi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti; paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samentīti … pe ….
segments.sn14.22:4.1: Kusītaṃ ekakaṃ vuttaṃ, suttantā tīṇi pañcakā;
segments.sn14.22:4.3: Bāvīsati vuttā suttā, dutiyo vaggo pavuccatīti.
